svg.title: HTTP fetch control flow: redirects, retries, and one request
svg.desc: Three panels generated from the Mermaid sources in docs/DECISIONS.md. createFetcher calls withRetry, which calls requestOnce. Open at full size to inspect the branches.
svg.text: Three nested responsibilities. Redirect traversal → per-hop retry → single HTTP attempt.
Policy, cached image-hop promises, and redirects
